The closed FCSTM shows the root initial edge [*] -> HumanDrivingMode carries the Power_On trigger rather than being an unconditional default entry; the deterministic verify_facts explicitly refute initial-entry for transition:line:28 (has_trigger=true, has_guard=false) and also refute event-consumer coverage for Power_On, whose only declared consumer transition (line:28) has zero reachable consumer state/transition refs. reference_inspection_facts independently flags W_INITIAL_UNCONDITIONAL_MISSING for the composite root. Distinct properties (element_declaration, containment/sub-state existence, initial_entry, transition_endpoints, guard, termination) are split into atomic contracts per segment while preserving discourse-resolved source/target roles per instructions. No progress/state_action contracts are manufactured since no continuous/repeated activity is explicitly stated. Guard-disjointness is not asserted since NL doesn't explicitly require distinguishability beyond the two named alternative transitions with different named events/guards, but two alternatives share source AutonomousMode/HumanDrivingMode with distinct events, so no disjointness claim added since not required explicitly.
